# What will that card processor really cost you?

> Free payment processing fee calculator: enter your monthly card sales, average sale and each processor's quote, and see the effective rate, monthly and yearly cost side by side. Flat rate vs interchange-plus. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
